title: How batteries work - Adam Jacobson
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】電池的工作原理 - 亞當雅各布森（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: You probably know the feeling.
cues.en: You probably know the feeling.
cues.zh: 你可能知道這種感覺 － 你的手機發出它最後、悽涼的「嗶」聲

cues.text: Your phone utters its final plaintive "bleep" and cuts out in the middle of your call.
cues.en: Your phone utters its final plaintive "bleep" and cuts out in the middle of your call.
cues.zh: 你可能知道這種感覺 － 你的手機發出它最後、悽涼的「嗶」聲 然後在你的電話講到一半就斷線了

cues.text: In that moment, you may feel more like throwing your battery across the room
cues.en: In that moment, you may feel more like throwing your battery across the room
cues.zh: 這時候你可能想把你的電池 扔到房間的另一頭過去

cues.text: than singing its praises, but batteries are a triumph of science.
cues.en: than singing its praises, but batteries are a triumph of science.
cues.zh: 這時候你可能想把你的電池 扔到房間的另一頭過去 而不是大讚其美言 但是電池是科學的大勝利

cues.text: They allow smartphones and other technologies to exist without anchoring us to an infernal tangle of power cables.
cues.en: They allow smartphones and other technologies to exist without anchoring us to an infernal tangle of power cables.
cues.zh: 但是電池是科學的大勝利 它們讓智慧型手機跟其他科技產品 不需把我們和惱人、 糾結不清的電源線綁在一起就能使用

cues.text: Yet even the best batteries will diminish daily, slowly losing capacity until they finally die.
cues.en: Yet even the best batteries will diminish daily, slowly losing capacity until they finally die.
cues.zh: 不需把我們和惱人、 糾結不清的電源線綁在一起就能使用 即便是現在最棒的電池也會日漸衰涸 慢慢地失去電量直到它們最終掛掉

cues.text: So why does this happen, and how do our batteries even store so much charge in the first place?
cues.en: So why does this happen, and how do our batteries even store so much charge in the first place?
cues.zh: 為什麼會發生這種事呢？ 以及電池是如何在剛開始 就存有這麼多電量呢？

cues.text: It all started in the 1780s with two Italian scientists,
cues.en: It all started in the 1780s with two Italian scientists,
cues.zh: 以及電池是如何在剛開始 就存有這麼多電量呢？ 這一切起始於 1780-89 年間的 兩位義大利科學家 － 「路易吉．賈法尼」 以及「亞歷山卓．伏打」

cues.text: Luigi Galvani and Alessandro Volta, and a frog.
cues.en: Luigi Galvani and Alessandro Volta, and a frog.
cues.zh: 「路易吉．賈法尼」 以及「亞歷山卓．伏打」 還有一隻青蛙 據說當賈法尼正在研究青蛙的大腿時

cues.text: Legend has it that as Galvani was studying a frog's leg, he brushed a metal instrument up against one of its nerves,
cues.en: Legend has it that as Galvani was studying a frog's leg, he brushed a metal instrument up against one of its nerves,
cues.zh: 據說當賈法尼正在研究青蛙的大腿時 他把金屬儀器輕碰上蛙腿的一條神經 使得蛙腿肌肉抽動

cues.text: making the leg muscles jerk.
cues.en: making the leg muscles jerk.
cues.zh: 他把金屬儀器輕碰上蛙腿的一條神經 使得蛙腿肌肉抽動

cues.text: Galvani called this animal electricity, believing that a type of electricity was stored in the very stuff of life.
cues.en: Galvani called this animal electricity, believing that a type of electricity was stored in the very stuff of life.
cues.zh: 使得蛙腿肌肉抽動 賈法尼稱其為「動物電」 他認為有一種電力型態 被儲存在生命體裡面

cues.text: But Volta disagreed, arguing that it was the metal itself that made the leg twitch.
cues.en: But Volta disagreed, arguing that it was the metal itself that made the leg twitch.
cues.zh: 他認為有一種電力型態 被儲存在生命體裡面 但是伏打不認同 他指出是金屬本身使得蛙腿抽搐

cues.text: The debate was eventually settled with Volta's groundbreaking experiment.
cues.en: The debate was eventually settled with Volta's groundbreaking experiment.
cues.zh: 他指出是金屬本身使得蛙腿抽搐 該爭論最終平息於 「伏打」開創性的實驗下

cues.text: He tested his idea with a stack of alternating layers of zinc and copper,
cues.en: He tested his idea with a stack of alternating layers of zinc and copper,
cues.zh: 該爭論最終平息於 「伏打」開創性的實驗下 他用了一堆交疊的鋅片與銅片 來驗證他的想法 用被鹽水試劑浸濕的紙或布料隔開

cues.text: separated by paper or cloth soaked in a salt water solution.
cues.en: separated by paper or cloth soaked in a salt water solution.
cues.zh: 用被鹽水試劑浸濕的紙或布料隔開 在伏打的電池裡所發生的是化學家 現在稱做「氧化、還原」的現象

cues.text: What happened in Volta's cell is something chemists now call oxidation and reduction.
cues.en: What happened in Volta's cell is something chemists now call oxidation and reduction.
cues.zh: 在伏打的電池裡所發生的是化學家 現在稱做「氧化、還原」的現象 鋅片氧化代表它失去了電子

cues.text: The zinc oxidizes, which means it loses electrons,
cues.en: The zinc oxidizes, which means it loses electrons,
cues.zh: 鋅片氧化代表它失去了電子 該電子接著被水中的離子在叫做 「還原」的過程中取得

cues.text: which are, in turn, gained by the ions in the water in a process called reduction,
cues.en: which are, in turn, gained by the ions in the water in a process called reduction,
cues.zh: 該電子接著被水中的離子在叫做 「還原」的過程中取得 而產生出氫氣

cues.text: producing hydrogen gas.
cues.en: producing hydrogen gas.
cues.zh: 而產生出氫氣 伏打要是得知最後這一部分 也會感到吃驚的

cues.text: Volta would have been shocked to learn that last bit.
cues.en: Volta would have been shocked to learn that last bit.
cues.zh: 伏打要是得知最後這一部分 也會感到吃驚的 他以為該反應發生在銅片裡面

cues.text: He thought the reaction was happening in the copper, rather than the solution.
cues.en: He thought the reaction was happening in the copper, rather than the solution.
cues.zh: 他以為該反應發生在銅片裡面 而不是鹽水試劑中 儘管如此我們仍透過把電力的 標準單位命名為「伏特」

cues.text: None the less, we honor Volta's discovery today by naming our standard unit of electric potential "the volt."
cues.en: None the less, we honor Volta's discovery today by naming our standard unit of electric potential "the volt."
cues.zh: 儘管如此我們仍透過把電力的 標準單位命名為「伏特」 來紀念伏打的發現 該「氧化、還原」迴圈 在這兩種物質之間產生電流

cues.text: This oxidation-reduction cycle creates a flow of electrons between two substances
cues.en: This oxidation-reduction cycle creates a flow of electrons between two substances
cues.zh: 該「氧化、還原」迴圈 在這兩種物質之間產生電流

cues.text: and if you hook a lightbulb or vacuum cleaner up between the two,
cues.en: and if you hook a lightbulb or vacuum cleaner up between the two,
cues.zh: 如果你掛個燈泡或是吸塵器 在兩種物質間的上方

cues.text: you'll give it power.
cues.en: you'll give it power.
cues.zh: 如果你掛個燈泡或是吸塵器 在兩種物質間的上方 你將會給它電力 自從十八世紀以來科學家們已經在 伏打的設計上做了改進

cues.text: Since the 1700s, scientists have improved on Volta's design.
cues.en: Since the 1700s, scientists have improved on Volta's design.
cues.zh: 自從十八世紀以來科學家們已經在 伏打的設計上做了改進 他們以裝填了化學粘料的乾電池 取代了化學試劑

cues.text: They've replaced the chemical solution with dry cells filled with chemical paste,
cues.en: They've replaced the chemical solution with dry cells filled with chemical paste,
cues.zh: 他們以裝填了化學粘料的乾電池 取代了化學試劑

cues.text: but the principle is the same.
cues.en: but the principle is the same.
cues.zh: 他們以裝填了化學粘料的乾電池 取代了化學試劑 不過原理是一樣的 一端的金屬氧化送出電子

cues.text: A metal oxidizes, sending electrons to do some work
cues.en: A metal oxidizes, sending electrons to do some work
cues.zh: 一端的金屬氧化送出電子 在它們被另一項物質 重新取得還原前來做些「功」

cues.text: before they are regained by a substance being reduced.
cues.en: before they are regained by a substance being reduced.
cues.zh: 在它們被另一項物質 重新取得還原前來做些「功」 但是任何電池的金屬量是有限的

cues.text: But any battery has a finite supply of metal, and once most of it has oxidized, the battery dies.
cues.en: But any battery has a finite supply of metal, and once most of it has oxidized, the battery dies.
cues.zh: 但是任何電池的金屬量是有限的 一旦大部分的金屬已經氧化掉了 該電池也就掛點了 所以充電電池給了我們一個 針對這問題的短暫解決方法

cues.text: So rechargeable batteries give us a temporary solution to this problem
cues.en: So rechargeable batteries give us a temporary solution to this problem
cues.zh: 一旦大部分的金屬已經氧化掉了 該電池也就掛點了 所以充電電池給了我們一個 針對這問題的短暫解決方法

cues.text: by making the oxidation-reduction process reversible.
cues.en: by making the oxidation-reduction process reversible.
cues.zh: 透過讓「氧化、還原」過程 能倒過頭來做的 電子可以憑藉電力的運用來流回相反方向

cues.text: Electrons can flow back in the opposite direction with the application of electricity.
cues.en: Electrons can flow back in the opposite direction with the application of electricity.
cues.zh: 電子可以憑藉電力的運用來流回相反方向 插上充電器從牆上的插座把電力匯出

cues.text: Plugging in a charger draws the electricity from a wall outlet that drives the reaction to regenerate the metal,
cues.en: Plugging in a charger draws the electricity from a wall outlet that drives the reaction to regenerate the metal,
cues.zh: 插上充電器從牆上的插座把電力匯出 帶動反應來讓金屬再生 使得你在下次需要它們的時候 氧化時能有更多電子可取得

cues.text: making more electrons available for oxidation the next time you need them.
cues.en: making more electrons available for oxidation the next time you need them.
cues.zh: 使得你在下次需要它們的時候 氧化時能有更多電子可取得 但就算是充電電池也沒辦法永保安康

cues.text: But even rechargeable batteries don't last forever.
cues.en: But even rechargeable batteries don't last forever.
cues.zh: 但就算是充電電池也沒辦法永保安康 長時間下來重複這個過程

cues.text: Over time, the repetition of this process causes imperfections
cues.en: Over time, the repetition of this process causes imperfections
cues.zh: 長時間下來重複這個過程 造成金屬的表面有瑕疵、不規則 使它不能好好地氧化、

cues.text: and irregularities in the metal's surface that prevent it from oxidizing properly.
cues.en: and irregularities in the metal's surface that prevent it from oxidizing properly.
cues.zh: 造成金屬的表面有瑕疵、不規則 使它不能好好地氧化、

cues.text: The electrons are no longer available to flow through a circuit and the battery dies.
cues.en: The electrons are no longer available to flow through a circuit and the battery dies.
cues.zh: 電子不再能夠在迴路上流動 這個電池就掛點了 有些每天充電的電池

cues.text: Some everyday rechargeable batteries will die after only hundreds of discharge-recharge cycles,
cues.en: Some everyday rechargeable batteries will die after only hundreds of discharge-recharge cycles,
cues.zh: 有些每天充電的電池 只做幾百回充、放電迴圈後就會掛點掉 同一時間比較新、先進的電池 可以撐過執行數千回的迴圈

cues.text: while newer, advanced batteries can survive and function for thousands.
cues.en: while newer, advanced batteries can survive and function for thousands.
cues.zh: 同一時間比較新、先進的電池 可以撐過執行數千回的迴圈 未來的電池可能是既輕又薄的薄片

cues.text: Batteries of the future may be light, thin sheets that operate on the principles of quantum physics
cues.en: Batteries of the future may be light, thin sheets that operate on the principles of quantum physics
cues.zh: 未來的電池可能是既輕又薄的薄片 在量子物理學的原理下運作 而且撐過幾十萬回的充電迴圈

cues.text: and last for hundreds of thousands of charge cycles.
cues.en: and last for hundreds of thousands of charge cycles.
cues.zh: 在量子物理學的原理下運作 而且撐過幾十萬回的充電迴圈

cues.text: But until scientists find a way to take advantage of motion to recharge your cell battery, like cars do,
cues.en: But until scientists find a way to take advantage of motion to recharge your cell battery, like cars do,
cues.zh: 不過直到科學家們找到方法 利用動能來讓你的手機電池充電以前 就像汽車的動能回充 或是把太陽能板裝進 你的電子裝置的某處以前

cues.text: or fit solar panels somewhere on your device, plugging your charger into the wall,
cues.en: or fit solar panels somewhere on your device, plugging your charger into the wall,
cues.zh: 就像汽車的動能回充 或是把太陽能板裝進 你的電子裝置的某處以前 把你的充電器插進牆上的插座 而不是耗費一個電池去充另外一個

cues.text: rather than expending one battery to charge another is your best bet to forestall that fatal "bleep."
cues.en: rather than expending one battery to charge another is your best bet to forestall that fatal "bleep."
cues.zh: 把你的充電器插進牆上的插座 而不是耗費一個電池去充另外一個 是你預先防止要命的「嗶」聲最好方法
